description: Mirage IIIEBR FAB 4926 mounted in a public plaza at the entrance to Gama, opened 4 Aug 2010 by the FAB's COMGAR commander (Poder Aéreo). ABRAPAC 2019 quoted 4916, which is the airframe at COMDABRA; 4926 is followed. 767 Google reviews (4.7) as of 2025.
aliases: F103; F-103E; F103E; Mirage IIIEBR; Mirage III; Mirage 3
museum_name: Praça do Avião Mirage III, Gama
